data.answer:
**Possibly, but the evidence does not establish causation.** The 2020 report records a sharp fall in ICT-related design applications in 2009 and says this “may reflect” the global financial crisis. Its discussion covers digital products such as mobile phones and laptop computers.[1]

The decline was not sustained: after 2009, ICT-related applications recovered quickly, trebling to 746 in 2013, or 10.8 per cent of all design applications.[2]

claims.text: The 2020 report identifies a sharp fall in ICT-related design applications in 2009 as a possible, rather than established, effect of the global financial crisis; its discussion includes mobile phones and laptop computers.

citations.quote: After 2009, ICT-related applications recovered quickly and trebled to 746 in 2013, reaching its highest percentage of total applications, 10.8 per cent, in almost two decades.

claims.text: After 2009, ICT-related applications recovered quickly and trebled to 746 in 2013, representing 10.8 per cent of total design applications.
